Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

3. Material — High speed steel 

NOTS — Unless otherwise soeclflsd, tbe high speed steel shall be eccordtng to T83W6Mo5Cr4V2 orTTOWISCritVl 
according to IS;729M974 'High speed tool steels', or equivalent, In which case the msjor constituents shall be 
specified by the manufacturer. 

4. Hardness — 760 HV MIn 

900 HV Man 

5. General Requirements 

5.1 The flutes may be straight or spiral at the discretion of the monufacturer. 

5.2 Hand of cutting, unless otherwise specified : Right.

5.3 The drills shall be manufactured in one piece and shall be free from cracks and burrs. 

3.4 The two cutting edges of the centra drill shall be diametrically opposite. 

5.5 The drill shall be properly sharpened and ready for use. 

6, Sampling — The sampling and criteria of acceptance shall be In accordance with 18:7778-1976 

' Methods for sampling small tools '• 

TvOesignation — A cer^tre drill type B, with protecting chamfers, having pilot diameter </ = V6 mm 
and shank diameter di =» 6*3 mm and confonnjng to this standard shall be designated as: 

Centre Drill B 1 6 x 6*3 IS : 6709 

8. Marking — Shalt be marked with type, pilot diameter d, shank diameter cfi and manufacturer's name 
or trade-mark. 

9.1 Certification Marking — Details available with XY\^ Bureau of Indian Standards. 

9. Preservative Coating and Paeking 

9.1 Each centre drill shall be covered with a suitable rust prooffng material. 

9.2 Each centre drill or a number of centre drills shall be wrapped in non -absorbent paper protected by 
a cover bearing the type, pilot diameter and shank diameter of the centre drill and manufacturers name 
or trade-mark. 

9.3 X)ne size of centre drills shall be packed in one carton. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first published in 1972. The present revision has been taken up to keep it in 
line withihe work done at ISO level. This standard is in full conformity with ISO 2540*1972 ' Centre 
drills for centra holes with protecting chamfers — Type B ' issued try the International Organization for 
Standardizatioiu
